I am the Founder of HS Tax Solution, established in 2008, with 18 years of professional experience in the field of taxation and tax consultancy.
Throughout my professional career, I have been actively engaged in providing tax consultancy, advisory and compliance services to individuals, partnerships and corporate clients. My professional experience covers various areas of taxation, including Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, Value Added Tax (VAT), Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL), tax planning, tax compliance and tax administration.
As the Founder of HS Tax Solution, I have taken responsibility for the overall management and development of the firm, maintaining professional standards, building long-term client relationships and providing reliable tax advisory services.
Over the years, I have gained extensive practical knowledge of Sri Lanka's taxation system, tax legislation and regulatory requirements. I have also been involved in assisting clients with their tax obligations, addressing tax-related matters and facilitating compliance with the requirements of the Inland Revenue Department.
I strongly believe in maintaining professional integrity, continuous professional development and ethical standards in the taxation profession.
I am committed to contributing further to the development of the tax advisory profession in Sri Lanka and sharing my practical knowledge and experience for the benefit of the professional community.

individualApplications.statement:
I possess approximately 24 years of extensive professional experience in taxation, encompassing individual and corporate taxation, direct and indirect taxes, tax advisory, compliance, dispute resolution and representation before the Inland Revenue Department (IRD), including over 10 years in senior professional and leadership roles.
From 2002 to 2020, I practised as an independent tax practitioner, providing comprehensive taxation services to individuals, professionals, executives and corporate clients. Subsequently, as Managing Partner of Avora Partners (Chartered Accountants), I have continued to lead, manage, review and oversee complex taxation assignments, while providing strategic tax advisory services to clients.
My individual taxation experience includes the preparation and review of income tax returns, tax planning for high-net-worth individuals, and advising on the tax treatment of employment income, investment income, rental income, capital gains and other taxable sources.
In corporate taxation, I have extensive experience in corporate income tax computations and returns, tax planning and optimisation, withholding tax, APIT, VAT, SSCL and other statutory tax obligations. My expertise also encompasses tax provisions, deferred taxation and taxation-related financial reporting.
A significant aspect of my professional contribution involves managing tax disputes and representing taxpayers before the IRD. This includes preparing and submitting appeals against assessments and determinations, handling tax objections, negotiating disputed tax liabilities, and addressing tax settlements, penalties and related matters.
Throughout my career, I have directly undertaken and managed taxation assignments, supervised and reviewed professional teams, interpreted and applied tax legislation, and advised clients on complex taxation matters. I remain committed to maintaining professional integrity, regulatory compliance and the highest standards of professional practice.
